# Edison Arias — Arias Latin Party

> Ecuadorian Latin DJ based in Houston, Texas. DJ, live sound engineering,
> and lighting for weddings, quinceañeras,
> birthdays and corporate events across the Houston area. 30+ years of
> experience. Bilingual (English / Spanish).

## About

Edison Arias (also known as DJ Edy Serrano) is a professional DJ and sound
engineer from Ecuador, now based in Houston, TX. He specializes in Latin
music and full-production live events, combining technical sound mastery
with high-energy entertainment. He has shared the stage with world-renowned
artists including David Guetta and Tiësto.

## Services

- **Latin DJ**: Weddings, quinceañeras, birthdays, corporate events, private
  parties and nightclubs. Styles: Cumbia, Salsa, Ecuadorian music, Latino
  House, Tribal House, Tech-House and Top 40.
- **Audio Engineering**: Live sound, equalization and mixing for bands and
  orchestras.
- **Lighting Design**: Intelligent beam sequences and atmospheric lighting.
- **Hora Loca**: Available on request, subject to availability.

## Service Area

Houston, Texas and nearby: Katy, Sugar Land, Pasadena, Pearland, Missouri
City, Cypress, Spring, Humble, The Woodlands, Baytown, League City, Conroe
and Galveston. Events outside the Houston area on request.
